title: Towards Trustworthy Autonomous Robots: An Explainable AI-Based Decision Framework
abstract: arXiv:2609.02861v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous robots powered by deep learning face a fundamental auditability challenge: when incidents occur, investigators cannot reconstruct why the system made specific decisions. This paper presents TRACE (Transparent Reasoning Architecture for Credible Execution), a decision framework that ensures every autonomous action can be traced back to sensor evidence through documented causal chains. The framework organizes decision-making into four auditable layers: Semantic Perception for evidence-grounded entity recognition, Belief Reasoning for probabilistic state estimation with causal graphs, Action Synthesis for constraint-aware planning with counterfactual documentation, and Execution Verification for compliance monitoring. TRACE is model-agnostic yet designed to integrate learning-based perception modules (CNNs, transformers) while preserving decision-level auditability. We evaluate the framework using three objective metrics: Evide

translated_title: 迈向可信赖的自主机器人：一种基于可解释人工智能的决策框架
translated_abstract: 由深度学习驱动的自主机器人面临一个根本性的可审计性挑战：当事故发生时，调查人员无法重建系统为何做出特定决策。本文提出了TRACE（可信执行的透明推理架构），这是一种决策框架，确保每个自主行为都能通过有据可查的因果链追溯至传感器证据。该框架将决策过程组织为四个可审计的层次：语义感知（用于基于证据的实体识别）、信念推理（用于结合因果图的概率状态估计）、行动合成（用于带反事实记录的约束感知规划）以及执行验证（用于合规性监控）。TRACE与具体模型无关，同时被设计为可集成基于学习的感知模块（如CNN、Transformer），并保持决策层面的可审计性。我们使用三个客观指标对该框架进行评估：证据……
tldr: 本文提出TRACE决策框架，通过语义感知、信念推理、行动合成和执行验证四层可审计架构，将自主机器人的每个决策通过因果链追溯至传感器证据，解决了深度学习驱动机器人无法解释决策过程的可审计性难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TRACE, a four-layer auditable decision framework that traces every autonomous robot action back to sensor evidence through documented causal chains, addressing the fundamental auditability challenge of deep learning-powered robots.
